title: From The Roof To The Water — EN/ES/FR (Pete McIvor)
style: country blues acoustic guitar warm baritone male vocal storytelling 100bpm walking bass brushed drums English Spanish French language learning trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
He built his first roof at twenty-two
Didn't think much about the ocean view
Just timber, tiles and sky above
That's a young man's work, that's a young man's love

[Verse 2 — Español]
Veinte años de tejados, calor de verano en Perth [Twenty years of rooftops, Perth summer heat]
Un día dijo que encontraría el mar, sin tener por qué [He said one day he'd find himself the sea, without knowing why]
No podía explicar por qué el agua lo llamó [Couldn't tell you why the water called]
Quizás porque desde cada techo, todo lo vio [Maybe because from every roof, you see it all]

[Chorus — English]
From the roof to the water, that's the road he took
Traded in the hammer for the anchor and the hook
Same man, same hands, same eyes looking far
From the roof to the water — that's who you are

[Bridge — Français]
Du toit à l'eau, c'est le chemin qu'il a pris [From the roof to the water, that's the road he took]
Il a échangé le marteau contre l'ancre et le crochet [He traded the hammer for the anchor and the hook]
Le même homme, les mêmes mains, les mêmes yeux au loin [Same man, same hands, same eyes looking far]
Du toit à l'eau — c'est qui tu es, c'est ton destin [From the roof to the water — that's who you are, that's your destiny]

[Verse 3 — English]
Pelican Charters, sunrise on the bay
Oldest son became the captain of the day

[Outro — EN/ES/FR]
From the roof to the water
Del techo al agua [From the roof to the water]
Du toit à l'eau [From the roof to the water]
That's my boy
